code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg=max(colors, key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    for color in colors-{bg}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        if len(pts)<2: continue
        # select a diagonal pair and its unit direction
        pair=None
        for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
            for rr,cc in pts[i+1:]:
                dr,dc=rr-r,cc-c
                if abs(dr)==abs(dc) and dr!=0:
                    g=__import__('math').gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc))
                    pair=(r,c,dr//g,dc//g); break
            if pair: break
        if not pair: continue
        r,c,sr,sc=pair
        while 0<=r-sr<h and 0<=c-sc<w:
            r-=sr;c-=sc
            if out[r][c]!=bg: break
            out[r][c]=color
        r,c=pair[:2]
        while 0<=r+sr<h and 0<=c+sc<w:
            r+=sr;c+=sc
            if out[r][c]!=bg: break
            out[r][c]=color
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(compile(code,p,'exec'))
print(transform(grid))
